title: Compose the complete balanced CRT state tree across changing precision with 127 stable owned roles (no new kappa)
body:
## Exact result and novelty
Composes the current numerical and ROM row state across a full balanced CRT tree with changing node size and precision, reusing 127 stable owned roles and preserving source/head history. A source-relative time envelope 2^34 * 2^(3ell) * (p+2)^8 and historical backing O(2^ell p ell^2+p^2) explicitly charge node visits. Extends the fixed-node boundaries of #5625/#6100, without claiming a full payload transform.

## Reproduction and independent checks
30 four-axis node-row commands, 28 unchanged ROM producer calls, independent CRT checks and 11 controls. Replay: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-whole-tree-state

## Limitations and bound status
No new kappa. Encoded topology/source, ROM payload transport, physical binary tariff and entire analytic recovery remain open. Selected conditional kappa remains 0.00363005817; the five framework assumptions remain.

## Attribution
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit #4195, #5625, #6100 and retained CRT providers.
